# Matcher evaluation (generated by `make evaluate`)

Synthetic labelled set, fixed seed. 60 fictional institutions (every distinctive word used by two
institutions: look-alikes), 280 typed names, 400 case pairs. Not real AICTE data.

## A. Typed name -> institution
A wrong institution counts as a false positive *and* a false negative. "Ambiguous" (two candidates within 5
points) counts as no suggestion.

| Method @ threshold | Precision | Recall | False-positive rate | False-negative rate | TP/FP/FN/TN |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| exact @ 100 | 1.00 | 0.34 | 0.00 | 0.66 | 61/0/119/100 |
| ratio @ 85 | 0.95 | 0.62 | 0.06 | 0.38 | 112/6/68/94 |
| token_set @ 85 | 0.97 | 0.97 | 0.06 | 0.03 | 175/6/5/94 |
| hybrid @ 80 | 1.00 | 0.96 | 0.00 | 0.04 | 173/0/7/100 |
| hybrid @ 85 | 1.00 | 0.92 | 0.00 | 0.08 | 166/0/14/100 |
| hybrid @ 88 | 1.00 | 0.87 | 0.00 | 0.13 | 157/0/23/100 |
| hybrid @ 92 | 1.00 | 0.80 | 0.00 | 0.20 | 144/0/36/100 |

Correct at hybrid @ 80, by variant: abbrev 26/26, abbrev+city 22/22, city 24/24, drop 23/27, generic only 40/40, misspell 28/29, misspell+abbrev 23/24, not in list 60/60, upper 27/28.
